title: Warm Greek Tofu Skillet
description: A light and refreshing Greek-inspired brunch dish featuring crispy tofu and a hint of ginger cordial, all cooked to perfection in a cast-iron skillet.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 4 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger cordial, kalamata olives, parsley, lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve the Warm Greek Tofu Skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Cook the skillet over low heat for an additional 2 minutes before serving.
Remove the skillet from the heat and let it cool for 1 minute before serving.
